mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id AS runId, sequence, captured_at_ms AS capturedAtMs, spindle_speed AS spindleSpeed, feed_rate AS feedRate, cutting_depth AS cuttingDepth, cutting_width AS cuttingWidth, vibration_value AS vibrationValue, current_value AS currentValue, sound_value AS soundValue, force_value AS forceValue, force_x AS forceX, force_y AS forceY, force_z AS forceZ, wear_value AS wearValue, predicted_wear_value AS predictedWearValue, wear_rate AS wearRate, remaining_life AS remainingLife, stage, status FROM telemetry_sample WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT #{limit}
